# awscc_wickr_network (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::Wickr::Network. Creates and manages an AWS Wickr network for secure enterprise communications.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_level` (String) The access level of the network, which determines available features and capabilities.
- `network_name` (String) The name of the network. Must be between 1 and 20 characters.

### Read-Only

- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns the network.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `migration_state` (Number) The SSO redirect URI migration state. Values: 0 (not started), 1 (in progress), or 2 (completed).
- `network_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the network.
- `network_id` (String) The unique identifier of the network.
- `standing` (Number) The current standing or status of the network.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wickr_network.example
  identity = {
    network_arn = "network_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `network_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the network

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_wickr_network.example
  id = "network_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_wickr_network.example "network_arn"
```
